description: This file defines the interface DosingInstructions, which specifies methods for representing, serializing, validating, and extracting dosing instructions for drug orders within the OpenMRS healthcare system.

classes.name: DosingInstructions
classes.description: An interface representing various ways to encode and handle dosing instructions for medication orders.

methods.name: getDosingInstructionsAsString
methods.description: Returns a localized human-readable string of the dosing instructions based on the provided locale.

methods.name: setDosingInstructions
methods.description: Serializes the dosing instructions into a DrugOrder object.

methods.name: getDosingInstructions
methods.description: Retrieves the dosing instructions from a DrugOrder, ensuring they match the expected type.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the dosing instructions in the context of a DrugOrder, recording any errors.

methods.name: getAutoExpireDate
methods.description: Infers the auto-expiration date for the drug order, if possible; otherwise, returns null.
